units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 2:1">B. Bath. II, 1</cite> <he>ארבעה מן הש׳</he> four handbreadths from the rim of the stove.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 19a:3">Ib. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>שְׂפַת מחמצן</he> the border of the wash-pit; a. fr.—<he>קמי ש׳</he>, <he>קנה ש׳</he>, v. <cite ref="S01442"><he>קָמָה</he></cite>.

Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᶜ top המאדם אודם בש׳ he who reddens his lips (v. אָדַם; Naḥmanides reads: בטפה). Ib. XIV, 14ᵈ top כל שהוא מן הש׳ ולפנים any wound on the lip and further inside (in the mouth, opp. חָלָל III). Y. Macc. II, end, 32ᵃ, a. fr. בש׳ רפה with lax lips, with low indistinct speech; a. fr.—Pl. שְׂפָתוֹת, שְׂפָיוֹת (סְפָי); Du. שְׂפָתַיִם.
<cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 6:15">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. VI, 15</cite> <he>שְׂפָתָיו</he>, v. <cite ref="U01786"><he>שָׁפַע</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Moed Katan 15a:12">M. Kat. 15ᵃ</cite> (expl. <he>ועל שפם וכ׳</he>, <cite ref="Leviticus 13:45">Lev. XIII, 45</cite>) <he>שיהו שִׂפְתוֹתָיו מדובקות וכ׳</he> his lips should cleave to each other (he must not greet or answer greeting).

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 12:4">Koh. R. to XII, 4</cite> <he>בנות השיר אלו הש׳</he> ‘the daughters of song’, that means the lips; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 18:1">Lev. R. s. 18</cite> <he>שִׂפְתוֹתָיו</he>.

<cite ref="Ketubot 61b:3">Keth. 61ᵇ</cite> <he>את השפתים</he>, v. <cite ref="U01918"><he>שִׁרְבֵּט</he></cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 5:6:6">Y. Keth. V, 30ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>השפיות</he>, v. <cite ref="U01206"><he>שִׁלְבֵּק</he></cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 6:1:2">Y. Yeb. VI, beg. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>בין הש׳</he> between the lips (of the vagina).
